note: Submodule of markdownify. A route subscriber (MarkdownifyViewsRoutes) clones every non-admin Views 'page' display route into a Markdown variant handled by MarkdownifyViewPageController (renders the view, converts HTML->Markdown, prepends the title as an H1). No config, schema or permissions. KNOWN BUG on Drupal 11 1.1.x: the controller's create() does not initialise core ViewPageController's typed properties, so parent::handle() throws '$contextualLinks must not be accessed before initialization' and the Markdown view route 500s (verified live). Because the live output is broken on D11 there is no reliable hard-execution verify; cases are recipe + an enabled-state introspection, and the easy cases deliberately capture the known-bug fact.

evals.prompt: What does the markdownify_views submodule add to Markdownify, and which kind of Views displays does it target?
evals.expected_output: It extends Markdownify to Views 'page' displays (listing pages), cloning every non-admin Views page route (display plugin 'page', _format html) into a Markdown variant, so listing pages are reachable as Markdown via the same .md / prefix / header patterns.

evals.prompt: How does markdownify_views create the Markdown routes for Views pages, and how is the Markdown produced at request time?
evals.expected_output: A route subscriber (markdownify_views.route_subscriber / MarkdownifyViewsRoutes) clones qualifying Views page routes into Markdown routes pointing at MarkdownifyViewPageController::handle, which renders the view via core ViewPageController and converts the HTML with the markdownify.html_converter service, prepending the title as an H1.

evals.prompt: A developer reports that on their Drupal 11 site, requesting the .md version of a Views page (with markdownify_views enabled) returns an HTTP 500 mentioning ViewPageController::$contextualLinks. Is this a known problem and what is the cause?
evals.expected_output: Yes. MarkdownifyViewPageController overrides ViewPageController::create() but injects only the renderer and converter, so the parent's typed $contextualLinks property is never initialised; parent::handle() then throws 'Typed property ...::$contextualLinks must not be accessed before initialization' and the route 500s. It is an upstream bug in markdownify_views 1.1.x on Drupal 11.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Markdown output for Views listing pages (the markdownify_views submodule) currently available? Inspect the live site and say whether that submodule is enabled.
evals.expected_output: Yes — markdownify_views is enabled (e.g. `drush pm:list --status=enabled` includes markdownify_views), so its route subscriber generates Markdown variants of non-admin Views page routes.
